subject: RM_Rhossak
departures: legs, flanks and body are made of bundles of tightly wound, twisting living roots, with no fur or hide
the antler-like crown is a branching mass of root, not bone antler
a row of swollen seed-husks along its back
some husks split open to show wet red seeds packed like teeth
the ground beneath and around it is sprouting with new growth
